stock.description: Sanxun Holdings Group Limited functions as an investment holding company, primarily dedicated to the construction and marketing of residential real estate within the People's Republic of China. Additionally, the firm engages in trading operations. Established in 2004, its corporate headquarters are located in Shanghai, PRC. Sanxun Holdings Group Limited operates as a subsidiary under Q Kun Ltd.
